title: Hondo Ohnaka
description: Hondo Ohnaka was a resourceful and enterprising pirate based on the planet Florrum. The tough Weequay was a former colleague of Jango Fett's and a former lover of Aurra Sing. Mostly, he was a pragmatist, though, doing anything his heart desired as long as it benefited his favorite person: Hondo Ohnaka.
